description: RyTuneX is an advanced system tuning engine built with WinUI 3 and .NET, designed to debloat, optimize, and maximize performance on Windows 10 and 11.

latest_release.name: Version 1.8.0
latest_release.body:
# For more info, check [CHANGELOG.md](../main/CHANGELOG.md)

### Added

- Added accent color personalization in Settings to choose between RyTuneX style, Windows system accent, or a custom color.
- Added a dedicated `Stress Test` page to evaluate system stability and thermal performance under sustained loads.
- Implemented a multi-threaded **Stress Engine** (`StressEngine`) supporting CPU stress tests, RAM memory allocation testing, GPU compute workloads, real-time hardware telemetry (CPU utilization, temperatures, memory usage), customizable thread allocation, duration timers, and emergency temperature cutoff thresholds.
- Integrated the `Stress Test` page into the main navigation menu and in-app search indexing (`AppSearchService`).
- Implemented runtime dynamic code inspection in `OptimizeFunctionInspector` to analyze embedded helper source files (`OptimizeSystemHelper.cs`, `OptimizationOptions.cs`) and extract commands, registry keys, and technical summaries on the fly without hardcoded lists.
- Introduced a dedicated `Cosmetic` risk level to classify visual personalization, theme settings, desktop layouts, and context menu shortcuts as non-intrusive aesthetic preferences rather than core performance tweaks.
- Added `IntelligentCardEnhancer` to dynamically augment optimization cards with risk badges (`Safe`, `Cosmetic`, `Moderate`, `Caution`), point gain chips (`+X pts`), per-item rollback buttons, and rich technical detail flyouts across all pages.
- Introduced `IntelligentScoreHeaderControl` with domain-specific optimization scoring (Performance, Privacy, Features), interactive preset filters (`Recommended`, `Safe`, `Moderate`), score gain calculation, and preview dialogs.
- Added hardware-aware recommendations based on detected system specifications (CPU cores, RAM capacity, SSD vs HDD, desktop vs laptop, and GPU hardware).
- Introduced new Network Optimization toggles:
  - `Disable Network Throttling`
  - `Disable Nagle's Algorithm`
  - `Enable Receive-Side Scaling (RSS)`
  - `Enable ECN (Explicit Congestion Notification)`
  - `Enable Compound TCP (CTCP)`
  - `Disable IPv6`
  - `Disable P2P Update Delivery`
  - `Disable Hotspot 2.0`
  - `Disable NetBIOS over TCP/IP`
- Introduced Timer Resolution & Latency optimizations (`Optimize System` page):
  - `Enable Global Timer Resolution`
  - `Disable HPET`
  - `Disable Dynamic Tick`
- Introduced Memory Optimization toggles (`Optimize System` page):
  - `Disable Prefetch & Superfetch`
  - `Enable Large System Cache`
  - `Disable Network Data Usage Monitor (NDU)`
  - `Disable Page File Encryption`
- Introduced Notification Controls (`Features` page):
  - `Disable Lock Screen Notifications`
  - `Disable All Toast Notifications`
  - `Disable Notification Center`
  - `Disable Suggested Actions`
- Introduced Context Menu Customization options (`Features` page):
  - `Add "Take Ownership" to Context Menu`
  - `Add "Open Command Prompt Here"`
  - `Add "Copy File Path" to Context Menu`
- Introduced Privacy Hardening optimizations (`Privacy` page):
  - `Disable Wi-Fi Sense`
  - `Disable Web Results in Search`
  - `Disable App Launch Tracking`
  - `Disable Timeline & Activity History`
- Added status notifications and administrative permission checks when managing startup apps in `Startup Apps` page.
- Added multi-selection and batch removal support to the `Startup Apps` page #107.
- Added all new optimization toggles and network toggles to the in-app Search Engine (`AppSearchService`) with quick navigation and matching icons.
- Integrated all new toggles into the Intelligent Optimization Engine catalog with risk assessments, score weights, and technical details.
- Added Copilot+ PC / AI hardware capability detection in `System Info` page using Windows App SDK `AICapabilities`.
- Added persistent picker state (`SettingsIdentifier`) and user-friendly dialog titles across file and folder pickers.
- Added Windows OS update detection on star

detail.readme:
Streamline. Tune. Dominate.
An advanced system tuning engine for Windows 10 and 11. Built with precision, engineered for peak performance.

[![Downloads@latest](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/rayenghanmi/rytunex/total?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/rayenghanmi/rytunex/releases) [![Release Version Badge](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/rayenghanmi/rytunex?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/rayenghanmi/rytunex/releases) [![Issues Badge](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/rayenghanmi/rytunex?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/rayenghanmi/rytunex/issues) [![Closed Issues Badge](https://img.shields.io/github/issues-closed/rayenghanmi/rytunex?color=%238256d0&style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/rayenghanmi/rytunex/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed)
## 📥 Installation ### Option 1: Microsoft Store (Recommended) Install RyTuneX directly from the Microsoft Store for the best experience: **Benefits:** - Automatic updates - Verified and secure installation - Seamless integration with Windows ### Option 2: Windows Package Manager (WinGet) Install RyTuneX via the command line using WinGet: winget install --id 9PDH8M7HF2SQ > [!IMPORTANT] > Always install RyTuneX from the **Microsoft Store** to ensure authenticity and security (RyTuneX no longer provides packages for sideloading). ## 💡 Why Choose RyTuneX? - **Precision System Tuning**: Deep OS-level configuration to maximize responsiveness, speed, and reliability. - **Complete Control**: Granular management over system services, processes, packages, telemetry, and policies.
## 🤝 Join the Community Get the most out of RyTuneX by connecting with fellow users and sharing your configurations. Have questions or feedback? Let’s make RyTuneX even better together! ## ℹ️ About RyTuneX is an **advanced system tuning engine** engineered to elevate the **performance**, **privacy**, and **control** of Windows environments. Built with **WinUI 3** and **.NET 10**, RyTuneX delivers a native, responsive experience tailored for **Windows 10 (20H1 and up)** and **Windows 11**. Whether you are a **competitive gamer**, **power user**, or **system administrator**, RyTuneX equips you with low-level tuning controls, package management, policy enforcement, and telemetry blocking.
## 🌟 Core Capabilities - 🧠 **Intelligent Tuning Engine**: Hardware-aware recommendations, domain-specific scoring (Performance, Privacy, Features), risk classification badges (`Safe`, `Cosmetic`, `Moderate`, `Caution`), on-demand technical inspection flyouts, and per-item rollback. - ⚡ **Low-Level Latency & OS Tuning**: Fine-tune timer resolution, HPET, dynamic tick, memory caching, power throttling, and GPU/input latency alongside automated post-Windows Update re-application. - 🔥 **Multi-Threaded Stress Engine**: Built-in stability and thermal testing across CPU, RAM, and GPU compute workloads with real-time hardware telemetry, thread allocation controls, and emergency thermal cutoffs. - 🧹 **Debloating & Deep Clean Engine**: Remove pre-installed UWP/Win32 bloatware via native Windows Deployment APIs and reclaim disk space across 12 targeted caches (Shader Cache, Windows Update, Crash Dumps, Browsers, Prefetch). - 🛡️ **Privacy & AI Hardening**: Lock down OS telemetry, activity history, launch tracking, Copilot+ AI features, Windows Recall, and background data collection. - 🌐 **Network & Stack Optimization**: Configure custom DNS profiles and tune TCP/IP performance (`Nagle's Algorithm`, `RSS`, `ECN`, `CTCP`, `Network Throttling`, `NetBIOS`). - 🧰 **Unified System Management**: Control Startup Apps (COM Task Scheduler & Registry), active Processes, Windows Services, 27+ Group Policy categories, Security status, and WinGet packages. - 🚀 **Native AOT & WinUI 3 Architecture**: Compiled directly to native machine code (x64 Native AOT / x86 R2R) on .NET 10 and Windows App SDK 2.5.1 for near-instant startup and minimal memory footprint.
## 🏗️ Technical Architecture RyTuneX is built on a modern Windows development stack, leveraging a layered architecture for native speed, low overhead, and maintainability:

- 🖥️ **UI Framework**: Native rendering with **WinUI 3** and **Windows App SDK 2.5.1**, featuring XAML rendering optimizations (`DefaultStyleOptimizations`, `IconNoGridOptimization`), native `` chrome, Mica/Acrylic backdrops, and custom accent personalization. - ⚙️ **Native Compilation**: Written in **C# 14** on **.NET 10**, utilizing **Native AOT** (x64) and **ReadyToRun + ILLink Trimming** (x86) for self-contained deployment, zero JIT overhead, and sub-2-second cold startups. - 🔗 **Dynamic Engine & Service Layer**: Powered by decoupled services (`IntelligentOptimizationEngine`, `OptimizeFunctionInspector`, `StressEngine`, `DeepCleanEngine`) for dynamic runtime code inspection, pre-warmed state caching, and asynchronous execution. - 🔧 **Deep OS Interop**: Direct platform execution via **Win32 APIs (P/Invoke)**, **Windows Deployment API**, **COM (`Schedule.Service`)**, **WMI**, and **PowerShell** for registry tuning, native UWP/Win32 debloating, policy scanning, and WinGet management. - 🔒 **Atomic State & Rollback**: Real-time registry state detection (`SystemStateDetector`) paired with granular **per-item rollback** and a 1-click **Revert All Changes** failsafe. ## 📸 UI Preview

RyTuneX | Advanced System Tuning Engine

## 🚀 Usage Guide > [!WARNING] > Always create a system restore point before applying deep system tuning changes. - **🏠 Home**: Monitor real-time CPU, GPU, RAM, Disk, and Network usage graphs alongside quick system actions. - **⚡ Optimize**: Apply hardware-aware performance, memory, power, and timer/latency tweaks using preset filters (`Recommended`, `Safe`, `Moderate`), risk badges, and per-item rollback. - **🧹 Debloat & Deep Clean**: Uninstall pre-installed UWP/Win32 apps in bulk and run asynchronous **Deep Clean** scans across 12 system, browser, and GPU shader cache targets. - **🛡️ Privacy**: Harden Windows against telemetry, activity history, launch tracking, web search injection, and background data collection. - **⚙️ Features**: Customize context menus (`Take Ownership`, `Copy File Path`), notification behavior, taskbar layouts, and disable Windows AI, Copilot, and Recall components. - **🔥 Stress Test**: Benchmark CPU, RAM, and GPU stability under sustained loads with customizable thread allocation, real-time thermal telemetry, and emergency temperature cutoffs. - **🌐 Network & Security**: Apply low-latency TCP/IP network stack tweaks (`Nagle's Algorithm`, `RSS`, `ECN`, `CTCP`), assign custom DNS presets, and audit real-time Windows Defender, Firewall, BitLocker, and SmartScreen states. - **🧰 System Workloads**: Manage boot entries in **Startup Apps**, install software via **Packages (WinGet)**, clear overrides across 27+ categories in **Policies**, control live **Processes** and **Services**, and run system repair routines in **Repair**. - **📊 System Info**: Inspect detailed hardware specifications, battery health, Copilot+ AI hardware capabilities, and extract or import device drivers. ## 📱 RyTuneX for Android RyTuneX isn't just for Windows. **RyTuneX-Android** is the mobile edition of the tuning engine, built with **Jetpack Compose** and **Material 3** for **Android 8.0+**. - 🔓 **No Root Required**: Runs through **Shizuku** (UID 2000) via Wireless Debugging. - ⚡ **Hardware-Aware Profiles**: Live device telemetry with one-tap profiles (`Extreme Gaming`, `Adaptive Endurance`, `RyTuneX Fluid`, `Reset to Stock`). - 🎛️ **Display & Rendering Control**: Lock hardware refresh rates, adjust animation scales, force GPU rendering paths, and pre-compile apps with ART AOT. - 🔒 **Privacy & Network**: System-wide encrypted DNS-over-TLS (Cloudflare, AdGuard, Quad9, Google, or custom), plus reduced background radio chatter and telemetry. - 👆 **Touch Latency Boosts**: Tweaks aimed at a more responsive touchscreen.
> [!NOTE] > RyTuneX-Android is a separate project with its own releases and issue tracker. ## 🛠️ Get Involved RyTuneX is an open-source project. Contributions are welcome! Check out the [contribution guide](https://github.com/rayenghanmi/RyTuneX/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) to get started. ## 🌍 Translation ### Currently supported languages by RyTuneX:

🇺🇸 English (US)  •  🇫🇷 French  •  🇹🇳 Arabic  •  🇨🇳 Simplified Chinese  •  🇹🇼 Traditional Chinese  •  🇩🇪 German  •  🇯🇵 Japanese
🇷🇺 Russian  •  🇪🇸 Spanish  •  🇰🇷 Korean  •  🇧🇷 Portuguese (BR)  •  🇮🇹 Italian  •  🇹🇷 Turkish  •  🇮🇱 Hebrew  •  🇻🇳 Vietnamese  •  🇮🇩 Indonesian

> *More translations dynamically ship with each new release!* ### Want to add your language? 1. **Clone the File**: Clone the [Resources.resw](../testing/Strings/en-us/Resources.resw) file. 2. **Translate the File**: Translate its contents into your target language. 3. **Save and Structure**: Save the translated file as `Resources.resw` inside a folder named with your language code (e.g., `fr-fr` for French). 4. **Create a Pull Request**: Submit a pull request to the `testing` branch with the new `.resw` file inside the `Strings` directory. Thank you for helping make RyTuneX accessible to more users! ## 📄 License This project is licensed under the [GNU Affero General Public License v3.0](https://github.com/rayenghanmi/RyTuneX/blob/main/LICENSE.md). ## 📫 Contact - E-mail: [rytunex@gmail.com](mailto:rytunex@gmail.com) - Twitter: [@rayen_ghanmi_23](https://twitter.com/rayen_ghanmi_23) - Facebook: [@rytunex](https://www.facebook.com/rytunex) - Discord: [RyTuneX](https://discord.gg/gyBzyd364t) - Instagram: [@rayen.ghanmi.23](https://instagram.com/rayen.ghanmi.23) We’re here to support and listen to your feedback!
